notes.title: Golden Axe Idol - Escape The Room For Free!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is Mr.H, and here comes Golden Axe Idol - Escape The Room! This is a corporate game of Golden Axe Idol and Hypnosis Prison. When I start to make the game of Idol. I always want to make a corporate live stream. I think it will also happen in Business teetee.

I'm curious about your thoughts on this kind of short free game. Some idols I really like but haven't reached a fervent level of enthusiasm, so I thought of adopting a free short game format. However, if I have enough time and money, I'd like to make each one into a longer story.

The next game will be Business teetee, I hope I can finish it soon~
